title: Pain in the Necklace
description: Fethis Alor in Raven Rock will pay 500 gold for each East Empire pendant found in East Empire Company strongboxes scattered across Solstheim.

base_facts: I run a general goods shop from my house in Raven Rock.
I am bitter about living and working in Solstheim.
East Empire pendants were once employee incentives and are now valuable collector's items.
I will pay 500 gold for each East Empire pendant brought to me.
The pendants are found in East Empire Company strongboxes, which have expert locks.

LEARN_ABOUT_PENDANTS: I have told the traveler about the East Empire pendants and my interest in buying them.
QUEST_ACCEPTED: The traveler has agreed to look for East Empire pendants for me.
PENDANT_RETURNED: The traveler has brought me an East Empire pendant and I paid them 500 gold.
QUEST_COMPLETE: I have purchased every East Empire pendant the traveler brought me at 500 gold each.
There are 33 East Empire Company strongboxes scattered across Solstheim, each potentially holding a pendant worth 500 gold — up to 16,500 gold total.
The strongboxes were meant to restock over time, so our pendant-buying arrangement could have continued indefinitely.
The formal pendant-hunting arrangement between us has now concluded and the matter is closed.

beats.comment: Player learns about East Empire pendants from Fethis.
Player agrees to find pendants; sets stage 20 and displays objective 10.
Player returns an East Empire pendant to Fethis for 500 gold.
Quest removed from journal at stage 250.
